    local dir="/root/./.zoxide"
    local db="/root/./.zoxide/db.json"

    local matches=""
    if [[ -n "${query}" ]]; then
        matches="${query}"
    else
        matches="*"
    fi
    local best=""
    local best_score=0
    while IFS= read -r line; do
        path="${line%%:*}"
        score="${line##*:}"

            if (( score > best_score )); then
                best_score=$score

    if [[ -n "${best}" ]]; then
        cd "${best}"
    fi
}
